errors.text_span: “股权收购”、“芳纶”、“质押”、“股权转让”、“企业收购”、“高管变动”、“中标”、“解除质押”、“公司上市”、“企业融资”、“股权增持”、“企业并购”和“被合并”
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies five of the thirteen categories on the x-axis. The description lists '股权收购' (equity acquisition), '芳纶' (aramid), '股权转让' (equity transfer), '企业并购' (corporate M&A), and '被合并' (being merged), but the chart actually shows '股份回购' (stock repurchase), '亏损' (loss), '股东减持' (shareholder reduction), '企业破产' (corporate bankruptcy), and '被约谈' (being summoned for a talk).

errors.evidence: The label for the highest bar is '股份回购' (stock repurchase), not '股权收购' (equity acquisition) as stated in the description.
